definition: [ טָפַח ] verb extend, spread (Arabic be full to overflowing, abound ; Aramaic extend, spread ; טְפוּחָא a step, foot-length ; Late Hebrew טֶפַח a span (compare טֶפַח below)) — Pi`el Perfect טִפְּחָה Isa 48:13 טִפַּחְתִּי Lam 2:22 — 1. spread out the heavens Isa 48:13 (|| יָסְדָה ארץ ). 2. denominative from טֶפַח carry on the palms, dandle Lam 2:22 (|| רִבִּיתִי I have brought up, reared ).
